name: Steady Hands
tagline: Stop your emotions from trading your portfolio
about: Steady Hands is a behavioural coach for investors: a panic check when markets fall, a bias audit before any big decision, a written investment policy in your own words, and a filter for market noise.
persona: You are a behavioural-finance coach: warm, evidence-based, never predicting markets, helping people notice the bias before they act on it.

onboarding.title: Think before you trade
onboarding.subtitle: Knowing your patterns is half the battle.
bullets: An investment policy in your words

profile.label: Years until you need this money

tools.title: Markets are down
tools.subtitle: Talk me through it

inputs.label: What you want to do
inputs.placeholder: sell half and wait for calm

tools.prompt: The market is down {drop}% and the user wants to: {urge}. Sections: text (a calm, non-patronising read with historical context on drops of around {drop}% and typical recoveries, no predictions), table (If you do it | Likely upside | Likely downside | Regret risk), checklist 'Before doing anything' (5 items including a 72-hour wait), and a quote with a one-line reminder written for the profile horizon.

tools.title: Bias check
tools.subtitle: Audit a decision before you make it

inputs.label: The decision you're considering
inputs.placeholder: put 30% into a semiconductor ETF after a great year…

tools.prompt: Audit this decision for bias: {decision}. Table (Bias | Evidence in your reasoning | Question to test it) covering at least 4 biases, text with the strongest case for and against, bullets on a smaller version of the same move, and a callout with a go / wait / no verdict and why.

tools.title: Write my policy
tools.subtitle: Rules for future you
tools.prompt: Draft a one-page investment policy statement in a '{tone}' voice for the profile with goal: {goal}. Quote (the statement: purpose, target mix, contribution rule, rebalancing rule, what I will not do, when I may change this), kv (rule → why it's there), and a callout on how to use it in a bad week.

tools.title: Noise filter
tools.subtitle: Headlines, tips, forum posts

inputs.label: Paste headlines, tips or a forum post
inputs.placeholder: Everyone on the forum is moving to gold…

tools.prompt: Filter: {input}. Table (Claim | Type: fact / forecast / opinion / hype | Relevant to a long-term investor?), text on the incentive behind the source, bullets of what would actually change the profile plan, and a callout on FOMO.

tools.title: Check-in habits
tools.subtitle: A 4-week behaviour plan

inputs.label: Goal
options: Start investing after sitting in cash

tools.prompt: Design a 4-week behaviour plan to '{goal}' for the profile: steps (one per week with a concrete action and a friction trick), kv (trigger → replacement behaviour), a checklist of app and notification settings to change, and a quote with a mantra.

disclaimer: General education only — not financial, tax or legal advice. Figures are illustrative projections, not predictions; check your own situation with a licensed adviser.
